The three database driver implementations are:

- store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go — NewDB
- store/db/mysql/mysql.go — NewDB
- store/db/postgres/postgres.go — NewDB

The factory function that selects between them at startup still needs to be identified.

The factory function is `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go`.

NewDBDriver — store/db/db.go

Each dialect package exposes `NewDB` on its `DB` type (implementing `store.Driver` from `store/driver.go`). `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go` switches on `profile.Driver` (`sqlite` / `mysql` / `postgres`) at startup.
